source: Eclipse Phase: Morph Recognition Guide (Posthuman Studios, 2014)
conversion_conventions:
+5 SOM -> ST 14 | +10 SOM -> ST 20   (baseline SOM 15 = ST 10)
+5 COO -> DX +2                        (+10 COO -> DX +4)
+5 REF -> Basic Speed +2.00            (8 quarter-levels)
+5 COG -> IQ +2                        (+10 COG -> IQ +4, +15 -> IQ +6)
+5 INT -> Per +3                       (+10 INT -> Per +6)
+5 WIL -> Will +3                      (+10 WIL -> Will +6)
+5 SAV -> Smooth Operator 2
+5 to N aptitudes of choice -> N customization slots (NOT point-matched: the seven options run 15-45 pts of value and the slot itself costs 0, per Part III. COG->IQ+2 is 40, WIL->Will+3 is 45, SOM->ST+4 is 32.)
DUR x 0.6 -> HP   |   Armor x 0.75 -> DR   |   CP / 4 (round up) -> chargen points

extraction_caveat: This file is machine-extracted from the Morph Recognition Guide and is lossy. Known damage: 16 entries have an empty aptitude_bonuses field, and at least four of those were wrong rather than genuinely empty. Four entries have null durability. The implants field is empty for every synthmorph, which is an artifact, not a fact. Treat an empty field as unknown, never as zero.
